acquisition method: MS data were acquired in the data-dependent mode with 3 s acquisition cycle.
cleavage agent: Search parameters were MS accuracy, 6 ppm; MS/MS accuracy, 20 ppm; enzyme, trypsin
collision energy: The fragments were produced using CID with 35% normalized collision energy; fragmented using high-energy collision dissociation (HCD) with collision energy 30.
fractionation method: Crosslinked peptides were fractionated using SCX-StageTips following the published protocol for linear peptides
fragmentation method: The fragments were produced using CID; fragmented using high-energy collision dissociation (HCD)
instrument: LTQ Orbitrap Velos; Orbitrap Fusion Lumos
Peptides were analyzed on LTQ Orbitrap Velos; using Orbitrap Fusion Lumos (Thermo Fisher Scientific)
mass analyzer: The fragments were produced using CID with 35% normalized collision energy and detected by the Orbitrap at 7500 resolution.
precursor tolerance: Search parameters were MS accuracy, 6 ppm
ptm: fixed modification, carbamidomethylation on cysteine; variable modifications, oxidation on methionine
fixed modification, carbamidomethylation on cysteine; variable modifications, oxidation on methionine
